name: Image Generation
summary: POST /openai/v1/images/generations with a model behind an ApiManagement connection.
description: Tests gpt-image-2 image generation via the Foundry project endpoint with the model prefixed by the AI Gateway connection name. As of 2026-06-10 Foundry's /openai/v1/images/generations route does NOT parse the {connection}/{model} prefix and only looks up local deployments on the Foundry account; the request never reaches APIM. Tracking with the Foundry team.
notes: Reproduces 404 with 3 model variants (real, gateway-prefixed, fake) - all identical, confirming Foundry-side routing gap.
